Class S3StorageAdapter

java.lang.Object
edu.ai.lms.core.material.adapter.out.storage.S3StorageAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
CreateDownloadLinkPort, CreateUploadLinkPort, DeleteFilePort, VerifyFileUploadedPort
@Service public class S3StorageAdapter extends Object implements CreateDownloadLinkPort, CreateUploadLinkPort, DeleteFilePort, VerifyFileUploadedPort
Facade that delegates storage operations to the appropriate S3Client: - "prod" profile → DigitalOceanConfig's S3Client - "dev" profile → LocalStorageConfig's S3Client (LocalStack) Spring automatically injects the profile-active bean; this class adds helper methods and a uniform API on top of it.

    • listFilesByPrefix

      public List<String> listFilesByPrefix(String bucketName, String prefix)
      Lists all file keys in a bucket that match a specific prefix (folder). For example, passing prefix "course-1/" will return ["course-1/doc1.txt", "course-1/doc2.txt"].
      Parameters:
      bucketName - source bucket
      prefix - the folder path or key prefix (e.g., "course-1/")
      Returns:
      List of matching object keys

    • verifyFileUploaded

      public boolean verifyFileUploaded(String bucketName, String key)
      Verifies that a file exists in the bucket by issuing a HeadObject request. Returns true if the object is present, false if it does not exist.
      Parameters:

      key - object key to check

      true if the object exists, false otherwise

    • createPresignedUploadUrl

      public String createPresignedUploadUrl(String bucketName, String key, String contentType, Duration expiry)
      Creates a pre-signed URL that allows a client to upload (PUT) a file directly to S3 without requiring AWS credentials on their side.
      Parameters:
      bucketName - target bucket
      key - object key under which the file will be stored
      contentType - MIME type the client must send in the Content-Type header
      expiry - how long the URL remains valid (e.g. Duration.ofMinutes(15))
      Returns:
      pre-signed PUT URL string
